_README: C4.6's price table, dated. Read by M2-10b to turn measured token counts into an estimated cost. THE PER-TOKEN RATES ARE NULL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE -- see `why_the_rates_are_null`. Every token count in the reports is MEASURED from span usage attributes and is published; only the dollar conversion is withheld.
why_the_rates_are_null: B4 #7 -- 'cost of thought visible' -- is a REPORTING criterion and its published
measure is the TOKEN RATIO (thinking reasoning tokens / direct reasoning tokens),
which is measured from span usage and needs no price table at all. The dollar
figure is a convenience on top of it.
The rates below are null because nobody has verified the current per-token prices
for these exact dated model ids, and a published cost is a number a reader will
quote. An invented rate would make `est_cost_usd` look measured when it was assumed
-- the same substitution this project refuses for reasoning_tokens (ADR-001: if the
provider does not return them, cost-of-thought is ESTIMATED, not measured, and it
says so). A null renders as 'not priced' and cannot be mistaken for a measurement.
TO PUBLISH DOLLARS: fill in the two rates, leave `dated` at the day you checked,
and re-run `make stamp-reports`. Nothing else changes -- `est_cost_usd` is computed
from token counts that are already in every report.
B4 #10's spend line is UNAFFECTED: it is reconciled from the breaker's own spend
file (ADR-011), which records what was actually billed rather than what a rate card

generation.note: Local (ADR-001). gpt-oss:20b on ollama, on the operator's own hardware. There is no per-token price: the marginal cost of a generation call is electricity.

gpt-5-2025-08-07.role: escalation (MODEL_ESCALATE). Shipped OFF -- ADR-012, finding 16 -- so this rate prices a tier the demo does not run.
